data.text:
F50 is fixed in the Outcome's closing paragraph, and this note records why the round has no
RED and no GREEN.

The finding is that the Outcome claimed holding a withdrawn claim as data means it "cannot
quietly come back", where the mechanism holds only the words each sentence was written in,
in a subset of the files. That is a claim in prose about the strength of a guard, and it is
in the one document the guard deliberately does not read.

No honest RED was available, and inventing one would have been the defect the finding is
about. The scanner cannot fail on the Outcome, because F49 decided on the record that
reading the ticket file would make it an authority turbo must hash, so the file whose every
edit invalidates the recorded pass would be the file that records it, and because a document
whose job is to describe a withdrawal cannot do that without quoting the sentence it would
then be reported for. A test asserting that a particular phrase is absent from the Outcome
would go red on demand and would measure nothing about whether the claim is true; this ticket
refused that shape at F24 and took it at F37 only because F37's claim was about text in files
the scanner already read.

So this round is a correction with the measurement already in the journal: what the mechanism
covers is stated at `tables.ts`, the coverage of the scan is stated at
`sourcesThatDocumentTheSet`, and both were widened by F49 one round earlier. The Outcome now
says what the third answer buys and where it stops, and names the review as what reads the
Outcome.

Worth keeping beside it: F50 also found that the other two durable answers are supported by
the work rather than asserted, which is the half of that paragraph that survived. A reviewer
that returns a ticket for one sentence of a summary and confirms the rest is doing the thing
this ticket has needed most, and it is the fourth time the second reviewer has read a claim
harder than the work behind it.

This is the last of F47 to F50. The four were: a stated impossibility that was false, a stated
transitivity that was false, a narrowing that undid the round before it, and a summary
stronger than its mechanism. None was a defect in the schema.
